summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting the completion of a $1.5B issuance of perpetual preferred securities contingently convertible into ordinary shares (CoCos) via an accelerated book-building to professional investors. The CoCos pay 7.25% annual interest for the first 10 years, reset every 5 years at 283.7 bps over 5-year UST, and are callable under certain conditions. Conversion occurs if the CET1 ratio falls below 5.125% (currently 14.4%). The securities qualify as additional tier 1 capital under EU CRR. Admission to NYSE is requested. This is a routine capital management transaction, not a special situation.
